full_text: Member Grievance & Appeal Form. L.A. Care Health Plan. Purpose is to ask L.A. Care to initiate a Grievance or Appeal. Explains that appeals must be filed within 180 calendar days of the denial notice. Explains right to file grievances for failure of plan staff to provide trans-inclusive care. Submit to Appeals & Grievances, L.A. Care Health Plan, 1200 W. 7th Street, Los Angeles, CA 90017 or Fax to 213-438-5748. Directs urgent requests to Member Services toll-free at 1-888-839-9909.
